{{Quote|Here you see the suspected pirate vessel, ''GrimDeath I'', a totally converted Old Republic ''Victory''-class warship. ''[&hellip;]'' This vessel is responsible for raids throughout the Woldona system, ''[&hellip;]''.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Clayton Balrog]], at a briefing for [[Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]]|<ref name="Briefing2">{{WEGCite|story=The Briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
The '''Woldona system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Briefing2" /> located in the [[Sevetta sector/Legends|Sevetta sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' is set between the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|conclusion]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively.</ref> the converted [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[GrimDeath I]]'' was used by a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to carry out a series of raids throughout the system.<ref name="Briefing2" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dartibek-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|250px|''Voyages SF'' 13 places the Woldona system in the Dartibek sector.]]
The Woldona system was first mentioned in "[[The Briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', a [[1987]] supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Briefing1">{{WEGCite|story=The Briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]], later placed the Woldona system&mdash;misspelled as "Woldana system"&mdash;in the [[Dartibek sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

Although the entry for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galpos II/Legends|Galpos II]] in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' placed the world within the Woldona system,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|317|Galpos II}}</ref> the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square T-16 and the separate [[Galpos system/Legends|Galpos system]] in square S-15. [[Jason Fry]], the co-author of the ''Atlas'',<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> has stated that the star systems listed in Appendix section of ''The Essential Atlas'' are named after the most prominent planets or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers Galpos II to be located in the Galpos system.<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref>
